title: PDVSA Rig Explosion in Apure State Injures at Least 17 Workers
detail: An explosion at PDVSA's Colven 02 rig in Apure state, in Venezuela's central Los Llanos region, injured at least 17 workers late on June 29, including two with severe burns; some were transported to Colombia for treatment and others to the nearby town of Guasdualito. Apure's Citizen Security Secretariat attributed the blast to a "release of flammable gases." Chinese state media Xinhua reported a lower toll of 12 injured, illustrating the usual reporting spread on PDVSA incidents. The accident underscored the chronic disrepair of PDVSA's aging infrastructure at a moment when the state oil company's operational capacity was already strained by the earthquake relief effort.
